posts.name: Beacon80
posts.cooked:
I'm curious, how do people determine what decks they're using?

My group tends to go a bit random for heroes, with players picking whoever they feel like, although I'll usually try to patch up any missing roles we have. We usually pick a villain based on whoever we haven't played that often, then pick a setting that's vaguely appropriate.

I have an app that's supposed to put together a set of decks, but I kind of gave up on it after a "Medium" (75% win rate) got us slaughtered.

I have too many preferences, so I usually take the suport character slot (Legacy, Argent Adept, Team Leader Tachyon, Parse). For my powerhouse choices, I take Ra, Tempest, KNYFE, Setback. When I want to sit back and tank damage, I prefer Naturalist or Scholar.

posts.name: Azqa
posts.cooked:
My groups tend to use similar logic for choices.  Some people I play with prefer to stick to only 2-3 decks that they really like.  Others like to try ones that they haven't played recently.  Some folks just want someone they can use to cause straightforward destruction after a frustrating day at work.  I tend to choose based on what I think the group needs after others have picked, though there are times when I've chosen decks because there was a particular character I really wanted to play.  Occasionally we've gone with a randomizer app, but we generally prefer to go with player choice.

Unfortunately, neither of my regular gaming groups have played Sentinels recently since we've been trying out a bunch of other new games.

posts.name: susan_brindle

Our group has started choosing "Themes" to constrain our hero selection and encourage us to try interesting teamups. So far we've done all the magic heroes, all the tech heroes, all the "B-list" heroes (We defined B-list as being based on a character without a major movie (or game series, since Knyfe is clearly Commander Shepherd) (I think we ended up playing Unity, Naturalist, Omnitron-X, and Chrono-Ranger.)

 

I think maybe next-time we'll only do heroes who are good at melee or something
